description: Hardened, multi-language coding benchmark (artifact-graded): the candidate produces a program; a HELD-OUT grader runs it after and emits the verdict via exit code + reward file. Robust to verdict forgery and oracle reads. Run with sandbox=docker for untrusted code.
name: coding_command_starter

grader_files.grade.py:
import json, os, subprocess
GD = os.environ['GRADER_DIR']
spec = json.load(open(os.path.join(GD, 'spec.json')))
checks, ok = {}, True
for i, case in enumerate(spec['cases']):
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(['sh', '-c', spec['cmd']], input=case.get('stdin', ''),
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
        got = p.stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        got = '<error>'
    passed = got == str(case['expected'])
    checks['case_%d' % i] = passed
    ok = ok and passed
json.dump({'score': 1 if ok else 0, 'checks': checks},
          open(os.path.join(GD, 'reward.json'), 'w'))
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)

guards.sentinel: candidate cannot read held-out cases or forge the grader verdict
